description: Use this when the user wants something put online, shared as a link, or hosted. Publishes files to a live permanent URL at the chosen slug. Paths are stored exactly. Returns {url, slug, version, token?}. The token appears only on the first anonymous publish; store it. There is no recovery if you lose it.

files.description:
Map of relative path to file contents. Paths are stored exactly as given (a single top-level directory is not removed). Text as a string, binary as {"base64":"..."}. Example: {"index.html":"

Hi

","img/logo.png":{"base64":"iVBOR..."}}

merge.description: Add or overwrite only these exact paths on the existing site. Paths omitted from this call are left unchanged. Nothing is moved to the site root.

slug.description: Exact slug matching ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$ (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, 1-63, no leading or trailing hyphen). Invalid slugs return slug_invalid and are not rewritten. Reserved names (hello, my-page, www, api, docs, admin, mcp, blog, app, status, and other docs examples) return slug_reserved on a new claim. A token that already owns one can still update it. Omit for a random slug.

spa.description: Serve index.html for unknown paths (single-page apps).

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

ttl_seconds.description: Opt-in expiry in seconds. Omit for a permanent site.

name: publish_site
title: Publish a site
